faq_1_question: How can I track my order?
faq_1_answer: You can track your order from the « My Orders » section in your profile. You'll receive instant updates via push notifications, SMS, and email.
faq_2_question: What payment methods do you accept?
faq_2_answer: We accept online payment by bank card and cash on delivery across all areas we serve in Egypt.
faq_3_question: Can I change the delivery address after placing the order?
faq_3_answer: Yes, you can change it within the first 15 minutes from « My Addresses ». After that, please contact customer service.
faq_5_answer: Absolutely! We use advanced encryption and comply with all international data protection standards.
faq_6_question: Do you deliver outside major cities?
faq_6_answer: Yes, we deliver to most cities and regions in Egypt. Just enter your address at checkout to check availability.
faq_7_question: How can I contact customer support?
faq_7_answer: Reach us 24/7 via in-app chat, email at support@jomlastore.com, or call our toll-free number 0800-1985 (inside Egypt).
faq_8_question: Can I cancel my order after confirming it?
faq_8_answer: Unfortunately cancellation is not possible after final confirmation, but contact us right away if there's an issue – we'll do our best to help.
faq_9_answer: No hidden fees at all! Everything (products, delivery, taxes) is shown clearly before you tap « Confirm Order ».
faq_10_question: How do I use a discount code?
faq_10_answer: In the cart or at checkout you'll see a « Promo Code » field. Enter the code and the discount will be applied instantly.

privacy_intro: Thank you for using the Jomla Store application. We are committed to protecting your privacy and ensuring the confidentiality of your personal information. This policy explains how we collect, use, process, and protect your data while using our services.
privacy_section_1_content: We may collect personal information, order details, device data, and location information when permission is granted.
privacy_section_2_content: We use your data to process orders, improve app performance, send important notifications, enhance security, and provide accurate customer support.
privacy_section_3_content: We only share your data with delivery companies, payment providers, and analytics services. We do not sell your data to any external party.
privacy_section_4_content: We apply advanced encryption and security systems to protect your information from unauthorized access.
privacy_section_5_content: We use cookies to enhance the user experience, save preferences, and speed up navigation. Users can disable cookies from the browser settings.
privacy_section_6_content: You have the right to access your data, request modifications, delete your account, or opt out of marketing communications at any time.
privacy_section_7_content: We may update the privacy policy when necessary. You will be notified of major updates through the app or email.
privacy_section_8_content: For any privacy-related inquiries: support@jomlastore.com or call 9200-XXX-XXX.

developer_description:
Welcome to
The One System
We provide integrated and intelligent software solutions that redefine business efficiency, enabling companies to manage their operations smoothly and transform data into accurate decisions that support growth and expansion. Our systems are designed according to the latest technologies to work online with a strong and secure database structure, ensuring fast performance, system stability, and accessibility anytime and anywhere.
Our solutions feature flexible and easy user interfaces, clear information display, and highly accurate results, with professional integration with the "Meta" platform to send WhatsApp and SMS messages, opening direct and effective communication channels with customers. Our systems also support bilingual operations, managing multiple companies from one platform, and analyzing performance and data over extended periods for consecutive years, giving you a comprehensive view that enables you to plan with confidence and achieve real sustainability for your business.
More than 23 years of experience and innovation in specialized software for project management and providing software solutions.
